lines.label: tmpc8k3_g1q_region4
lines.text: antate Eovae ubilate Deo omnis terra ipisum evovac

lines.label: tmpc8k3_g1q_region5
lines.text: lamor meus ad te veniat deus pres domine Exandi evovae

lines.label: tmpc8k3_g1q_region6
lines.text: enedic anima mea dominum pr. ipsum evovae et visita

lines.label: tmpc8k3_g1q_region7
lines.text: nos domne in squintani Consfitenum exonasee Ron

lines.label: tmpc8k3_g1q_region8
lines.text: fitebor domino miiis in ore meo pres Paratum evovae
